entries.title: Exodus 1:1
segments: ¶Now these [are] the names of the children of Israel who came to Egypt; each man and his household came with Jacob:

entries.title: Exodus 1:2
segments: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;

entries.title: Exodus 1:3
segments: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;

entries.title: Exodus 1:4
segments: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

entries.title: Exodus 1:5
segments: All those who were descendants of Jacob were seventy persons (for Joseph was in Egypt [already]).

entries.title: Exodus 1:6
segments: And Joseph died, all his brothers, and all that generation.

entries.title: Exodus 1:7
segments: But the children of Israel were fruitful and increased abundantly, multiplied and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.

entries.title: Exodus 1:8
segments: ¶Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.

entries.title: Exodus 1:9
segments: And he said to his people, "Look, the people of the children of Israel [are] more and mightier than we;

entries.title: Exodus 1:10
segments: "come, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply, and it happen, in the event of war, that they also join our enemies and fight against us, and [so] go up out of the land."

entries.title: Exodus 1:11
segments: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh supply cities, Pithom and Raamses.

entries.title: Exodus 1:12
segments: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were in dread of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 1:13
segments: So the Egyptians made the children of Israel serve with rigor.

entries.title: Exodus 1:14
segments: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage-in mortar, in brick, and in all manner of service in the field. All their service in which they made them serve [was] with rigor.

entries.title: Exodus 1:15
segments: ¶Then the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of one [was] Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah;

entries.title: Exodus 1:16
segments: and he said, "When you do the duties of a midwife for the Hebrew women, and see [them] on the birthstools, if it [is] a son, then you shall kill him; but if it [is] a daughter, then she shall live."

entries.title: Exodus 1:17
segments: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the male children alive.

entries.title: Exodus 1:18
segments: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this thing, and saved the male children alive?"

entries.title: Exodus 1:19
segments: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, "Because the Hebrew women [are] not like the Egyptian women; for they [are] lively and give birth before the midwives come to them."

entries.title: Exodus 1:20
segments: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied and grew very mighty.

entries.title: Exodus 1:21
segments: And so it was, because the midwives feared God, that He provided households for them.

entries.title: Exodus 1:22
segments: So Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "Every son who is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive."
